scenes.headline: How rotating vectors tells attention where tokens are
scenes.sub: RoPE: rotations, relative offsets, and stretching to long contexts
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Hopscotch! Attention can't tell where tokens are. RoPE fixes that by turning vectors like the hands of a clock.

scenes.text: Rotate each query and key by an angle proportional to its position. The angle between them, and so their score, depends only on the distance.
scenes.say: Rotate each query and key by an angle that grows with its position. Then the angle between them, and their score, depends only on how far apart they are.

steps.say: In every layer, each token's hidden state is projected to a query and a key, as usual.
Split each head's dimensions into pairs. Each pair turns by the position times its own angle.
Dot a turned query with a turned key, and only the difference in their positions survives.
Values are never rotated. RoPE has no weights at all.

parts.note: turn the query by its position m
parts.say: Turn the query by its position, m.

parts.note: turn the key by its position n
parts.say: Turn the key by its position, n.

parts.note: two rotations collapse into one: the offset
parts.say: Undo one turn and apply the other, and what's left is a single turn by n minus m. Absolute position cancels.

scenes.label: Pairs that never finish a turn
scenes.say: With base ten thousand, eighteen of the sixty-four pairs never finish a turn in four thousand tokens. Longer inputs show them angles the model never saw.

items.say: Position interpolation divides every position, so all angles stay familiar, but neighbours crowd together.
NTK-aware scaling raises the base instead, so only the slow pairs stretch.
YaRN decides pair by pair: stretch the slow ones, keep the fast ones, and blend between.
Or train with a bigger base. Llama 3 uses five hundred thousand.

scenes.text: RoPE turns position into rotation, so attention reads relative distance for free, and long context becomes a question of angles.
scenes.say: RoPE turns position into rotation. Attention reads relative distance for free, and long context becomes a question of which angles the model has seen.

recap: Rotate q and k by position times theta_i
The score depends only on m minus n
Longer contexts: keep the angles familiar
scenes.say: Rotate, subtract, and keep the angles familiar.
